title: Eludite agent permission policy
description: The per-solution, committable permission policy for hosted agents (PLAN.md 5.3), in `.eludite/agents-policy.json` beside the solution file. Class `read` always runs and is not configurable, except where `browser` refuses a call outright. Every key is optional; a missing file is the defaults. Eludite rewrites the file when the user answers a permission prompt with Always Allow (adding a rule); it keeps unknown keys out and writes the keys sorted, so the file diffs cleanly.

edit_buffer.description: Agent edits of files: `review` (default) holds them as pending changes until accepted or rejected; `accept` applies them at once (still audited).

execute.description: Build, test, run, shell commands, unknown tools: `prompt` (default), `allow` or `deny`, unless a rule matches.

dangerous.description: Push, delete, external network: `prompt` (default) or `deny`, unless a rule matches.

rules.description: Decisions for specific tools, checked in order before the class default (execute and dangerous only). The first matching rule wins.

tool.description: The tool as the agent names it: an agent tool (`Bash`, `WebFetch`) or an Eludite MCP tool (`mcp__eludite__eludite-solution-open`, or just `eludite-solution-open`).

command_prefix.description: Only when the tool's `command` argument (a shell command) starts with this text.

browser.description: The browser commands (eludite.browser.*; brief 0024, ADR-0009). Every key is optional; a missing key is its default.

origins.description: Where an agent may send the browser without the call becoming dangerous (eludite.browser.navigate and tab_open with a url, open_external). Each entry is a host (`localhost`, `[::1]`, `*.example.com` for the domain and its subdomains) or a host and port (`localhost:5000`), for http and https; an origin (`https://example.com`: that scheme and host on any port; `https://example.com:8443`: that port only); a `file:///` path (file urls under it); `$workspace` (file urls under the workspace folder); or `$launch_urls` (the `applicationUrl`s of the workspace's `Properties/launchSettings.json` profiles). Absent: `localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, `[::1]`, `$workspace` and `$launch_urls`. `about:` urls are always allowed. Always Allow on an off-origin navigation adds its origin here, writing the defaults first when the list was absent, and keeps the list sorted.

network_bodies.description: eludite.browser.network_body: `allow` (default) or `deny` (agents are refused, with this policy named).

evaluate.description: eludite.browser.evaluate: `allow` (default: class execute), `prompt` (class dangerous, which prompts) or `deny` (agents are refused, with this policy named).
